state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The gap `nvs-check-workspace-is-not-contributed` is closed. `nvs.checkWorkspace` is contributed and registered, and it sends the server's fifth request of its own, `nvs/checkWorkspace`. The server answers it in its main loop, because it is the one request that changes what the server holds: it runs the workspace survey and index build again and answers with the number of indexed files. `rule:ide/the-request-set-is-closed` and `rule:ide/check-scope-defaults-to-the-workspace` say so, and `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/references.rs` tests it.

A `decimal` *property* default is still refused (`E0472`), because `nvs_runtime::FieldDefault` has no `decimal` recipe. The module doc of `crates/nvs-types/src/defaults.rs` says so.

`startsWith` and `endsWith` still compare bytes. Whether they join the search family is still open.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest: 24 gaps in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-types`, `nvs-runtime`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.

items.text: **The guided install is reached by a command** (gap `the-guided-install-is-reached-by-no-command`, `rule:ide/the-extension-guides-an-install-and-never-bundles-one`). Register `nvs.downloadBinary` and `nvs.openReleases` beside the others at `editors/vscode/src/extension.ts:127`, contribute both after `nvs.checkWorkspace` in `editors/vscode/package.json:229`, add the managed copy as the last candidate at `editors/vscode/src/binary.ts:32`, and add both to the roster at `editors/vscode/test/contributions/contributions.test.ts:98`. The gap's text lists the rest: the status item, the mismatch offer, the reference section and the rule's status.

**The reference's command table is current** — `docs/reference/tools/40-editor.md:308` still says `nvs.run`, `nvs.test` and `nvs.showAst` are "not yet answered", and `editors/vscode/src/extension.ts:118` registers all three.
